title: lodestonehomes
description: Allows you to teleport to the location of your lodestone
body:
# LodestoneHomes
  
  Teleport to any **lodestone compass** destination by simply sneaking and right-clicking.

  ## How It Works

  1. Link a compass to a lodestone (vanilla mechanic)
  2. Sneak + right-click the compass
  3. Stand still for the countdown
  4. Teleport!

  Moving during the countdown cancels the teleport.

  ## Features

  - **No commands** — pure item interaction
  - **Configurable delay** — default 5 seconds, adjust in `config.yml`
  - **Movement cancellation** — prevents abuse, encourages commitment
  - **Action bar countdown** — live feedback during teleport
  - **Fully configurable messages & sounds** — per-event control over chat messages, action bar text, and sound effects
  - **Permission support** — `me.bishops_exe.lodestonehomes.allow_teleporting` (granted to all players by default)
  
## Configuration

All configuration is handled inside `./plugins/lodestonehomes/config.yml`.
Please check out the default configuration.
